name: gi-residential-property-disposals
description: Screen Gibraltar residential-property disposals for the Income Tax Act's five-property and five-basis-period rules. Covers direct and indirect interests, off-plan rights, property-holding entity share sales, excluded properties, connected interests and specified disposal exceptions. Provides scope and conditional tax examples that recompute. Based on primary legislation checked in October 2026. This source-cited draft does not establish acquisition-cost methodology, all historical commencement cases, treaty treatment or a filing-ready gain calculation; independent review remains pending. Use for 2026 disposal screening and taxpayer evidence collection before a separate computation, return or payment decision.
